comment: Forms of government (GDD 7.2; stage 4f, ADR 0023). title: the civilization's title, {people} is the people's name. fromEra: the first era (key from eras.json) in which a civilization may take it. enactYears: years before a state decision (a new government, a declared war: its armies wait) takes effect; very fast 0, fast 1, medium 2, slow 4. reviewPercent: the strategist and the diplomat review this many percent of their usual interval (lower = a faster state). cautionShift: added to the civilization's caution (per mille) when the AI decides whether to take its best option outright; negative = more impulsive. goalPercent: percent applied to the strategist's goal weights (expansion, security, prosperity, science, influence, conquest); missing goals stay 100. leaning: how much each trait draws a new people to this government at the start; the government with the highest sum of trait x leaning wins (ties: the first). Despotism and the city republic come with the bronze age (stage 6). Leaders (stage 4f PR 2, GDD 7.5): leaderTitle styles the leader; succession: council (the council weighs several candidates and takes the one closest to the people's character), strongest (the strongest warrior), hereditary (the heir), election (a new leader every termYears); successorAge: age range of a new leader; crisisPercent: chance a change of leader brings a succession crisis lasting crisisYears (it lowers stability). Stability (stage 4f PR 3, GDD 7.3, data/stability.json): stabilityBonus is added to stability; administration is the points of administration the state manages before it is overloaded; reach is the road cost from the capital (see stability.json) beyond which a settlement owes the state no loyalty (0 = no limit): small for tribal governments, so a neolithic people cannot hold a whole island and its far villages drift away as new peoples (stage 5b); strataInfluence is the political influence of each stratum (key from strata.json; missing = 1): stability weighs the mood of each settlement by its people times their influence. Since stage 6 PR 2 (decision of 2026-11-09) durations of war, diplomacy and politics are years of action: one year = 12 months of action = 60 ticks = 6 s at x1 (time.json).
